text:
michelle: Heads-up — Acme (acct: acme-42) reports a month-end mismatch: dashboard shows 1,205,412 tokens for Jan, invoice line shows 1,353,998. Can billing ops pick this up? It looks like it spikes right around the plan change on 2026-01-28.
omar: on it. please paste invoice + line ids and the dashboard snapshot time.
michelle: invoice INV-2026-ACME-01, line line_8923. dashboard snapshot run: 2026-02-01T00:05Z. Account switched standard -> pro at 2026-01-28T23:20Z. Acme also ran a big embed job 01/29.
sanjay: possible causes: overlapping aggregation windows or a billing backfill double-marking events. Also check whether embedding meters were accidentally included/excluded — embeddings vs generation counts sometimes get mixed across meter tags.
michelle: confirmed they used embed pipeline heavily. dashboard shows separate embed meter but invoice linetype is "standard_usage" — curious that invoice is larger.
elain? (cc finance) — can you see if any backfill or retry hit around 02-01?
elaine: from finance: billing-binder job ran a retry batch at 2026-02-01T01:10Z due to a transient DB lock. That job marks events as billed; if retries don't dedupe by unique_request_id we can double-assign some events. I'll pull the binder audit logs.
omar: repro steps I'm going to run:
1) export meter_events for acme-42 for 2026-01-27..2026-01-31 (group by request_id)
2) pull billing-binder audit: /var/log/billing-binder/2026-02-01.log
3) compare events with invoice line using invoice.line_id=line_8923
sanjay: quick hint — search for request_ids starting with "r-ff"; we've seen those appear twice in a previous binder retry bug. Also check meter-aggregator snapshots around plan-change boundaries; snapshot windows can include both pre- and post-change tags if cutover happens during snapshotting.
billing-bot: deploy success: billing-binder v1.4.2 retry-fix deployed to prod at 2026-02-01T01:12Z :rocket:
omar: pulling logs now, will run a diff and report token delta. assigning @sanjay to look at runtime code path that stamps billed=true in two places.
sanjay: found pattern — ~1,300 events for acme where the same request_id appears twice: one entry stamped before the plan-change with tier=standard and a second stamped after with tier=pro. billing-binder previously keyed on (account, ts) not request_id during retry dedupe. I've opened GH issue #4382 and a small patch to dedupe by unique_request_id.
elaine: preliminary finance estimate: duplicated events = ~148,586 tokens => ~$121. We'll hold issuing corrective credit until confirm. Preparing credit note draft (CR-2026-ACME-01) pending final verification.
michelle: thanks all. please update this thread with the final confirmed token delta and ETA for the corrective invoice/credit. Acme expects reconciliation this week.
